8. ADJUST DOOR OUTSIDE HANDLE
(a) Disconnect the control link.
(b) Raise the handle 0.5 — 1.0 mm (0.020 — 0.039 in.) from the rest position.
(c) Fit the pin into the hole.

9. ADJUST DOOR LOCK STRIKER
(a) Check that the door fit and door lock linkages are adjusted correctly.
(b) Adjust the striker by loosening the striker mounting screws.

10. INSTALL REGULATOR MOTOR
NOTE: Place the wire connector through the outside of the door panel.
(a) Install the regulator motor through the service hole.
(b) Tighten the mounting bolts.

11. INSTALL DOOR GLASS
(a) Install the front lower frame.
(b) Install the glass guide into the door panel.
(c) Install the glass into door panel.
(d) Install the glass to the lift arm bracket of the regulator.

12. INSTALL FOLLOWING PARTS:
(a) Trim support
(b) Upper stopper
(c) Inner stabilizer
